resources.observerCpuScope: Whole Python runner process, including sampling/gzip/source checks/orchestration; not child CPU

measurementLimits: Owned process sampling is periodic; short-lived processes may be missed. PID birth identities retained; zombies distinguished from live execution.
Cgroup CPU includes shared services and observer. Throttled counter delta is not a per-operation lost-wall-time estimate.
Peak memory uses sampled memory.current; lifetime memory.peak not attributed to this phase.
Limited workload mix preserves 4 CPU, 17GiB and worker cap, not the complete original 235-method launch/cache history.

remainingUncertainty: Original native ButtonGame 90s predicate not reproduced in three six-gate attempts.
Initial diagnostic A Pause ACK0 failure occurred before close; no result-code trace then; later instrumented attempts did not reproduce it.
Exact original 235-method launch/cache/shared-service history not captured; paired scheduling result does not exclude all product races.
Terminated runtime zombies reparented to PID1 persist during observation; no PID1/subreaper/authority change; not proven cause of original deadlines.
Sampling can miss short-lived processes; runner CPU and shared services contribute to measured cgroup usage; no whole-OS/device/account claims.
